scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.deploy: npm run build:vercel -w apps/web && vercel link --cwd apps/web/dist --yes --project tekkie && vercel deploy --cwd apps/web/dist --prod --yes
scripts.build:render: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w server && node scripts/package-extension.mjs
